There is a round image on the rocks below the two women on the artwork for the MOL book cover. Anyone have any idea what it is? I tried enlarging it but it was too distorted. It is definitely not just a random rock formation.
: If you are referring to the symbol I think you mean (maroon circle with a maroon rune on a black background) I think there's no mystery there; it's the artist's signature or symbol or seal or whatever.  Anyone want to offer a second opinion? [[User:Pedantic|Pedantic]] 20:30, May 21, 2012 (UTC)
::I just got a tweet from Peter Ahlstom, Brandon Sanderson's assistant. It is [[Michael Whelan]]'s monogram. You can see it more clearly at the top of his website: [http://www.glassonion.com/catalog/home.php] ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 15:41, May 22, 2012 (UTC)
